details: Upcoming releases of US April non-farm payroll and CPI data, along with Federal Reserve monetary policy meeting minutes, are set to significantly influence market risk appetite and macroeconomic expectations for May. Crypto investors are closely watching these events for signals on inflation and potential changes in monetary policy.
title: US Macro Data & Fed Meetings to Guide Crypto Market

details: Crypto market sentiment saw a notable 13-point increase in the Fear & Greed Index in the last 24 hours, even without significant price movement. This positive shift is largely attributed to the "CLARITY Act's stablecoin yield resolution," recently published by Senators Tillis and Alsobrooks. The resolution aims to protect platform rewards tied to genuine activity while disallowing interest on stablecoin holdings, a development reportedly viewed favorably by entities like Coinbase.
title: CLARITY Act Boosts Crypto Sentiment on Stablecoin Yield

details: The European Central Bank maintained interest rates at its April 30 meeting, but President Christine Lagarde's statements signaled a potential rate hike in June. Lagarde emphasized intensifying risks to both inflation and economic growth, leading markets to price in approximately 50 basis points of tightening by year-end. This hawkish stance could impact global liquidity.
title: ECB Hints at June Rate Hike Amid Inflation and Growth Risks

details: Large banks have significantly increased their holdings of Treasury securities to the highest levels since the Global Financial Crisis. This move reflects the impact of recently finalized changes to the enhanced supplementary leverage ratio, which went into effect on April 1, 2026, aiming to improve Treasury market liquidity.
title: Large Banks Increase Treasury Holdings Amid Capital Rule Changes
